In this Tuesday Technical Talk, Vishal B Malkan explains the Grandfather-Father-Son (GFS) Strategy — a simple multi-timeframe approach using RSI to understand trend alignment across monthly, weekly, and daily charts.

The core idea is straightforward: the higher timeframe has greater influence. In the example used in the session, the monthly and weekly charts remain strong while the daily chart comes near an important RSI support zone, creating a possible setup to study.

Vishal also walks through multiple historical chart examples to explain how the setup behaves in different market conditions and why every trade does not move immediately after entry.

The session reinforces an important principle: define your setup, risk, stop loss, target and risk-reward before taking a trade instead of making decisions randomly.
